purpose: Read-only experiment: per-base origins, both model axes aligned with the forward rig frame
assumptions: Each model origin is its own physical A10 base centre; both axis sets match the rig: x forward, y left, z up
This deliberately removes the A10 right native base's 180 degree yaw from model positions AND orientations
Model EE is represented by A10 tool0, not its grasp centre
A10 raw closure fraction maps linearly to model gripper opening in radians
The native-base trial produced state_coordinate_origin_ood and a 0.305m right first-step jump; this is a hypothesis for read-only validation, not a calibration
